reviews.title: Ruined Planetary Hours
reviews.text: The app was excellent, but after the recent unnecessary update, you can now only click through the days on the planetary hours section 1 day at time, which makes planning a nightmare. I hope they fix that issue asap, or I shall have to find a different app.

reviews.title: subscription issue
reviews.text:
I purchased this app many years ago and used it to access general information, including detailed descriptions of lunar days, lunar cycles, and so on. At that time, I paid for the app in full, and this information was readily available. However, it now appears that a subscription is required to continue accessing this information, which I am not willing to purchase. I have therefore decided to stop using the app and rely on online sources instead.
I find it completely unacceptable to sell the app over and over again to those who have already purchased it once.

reviews.title: No more free app
reviews.text: That stinks to high heaven that this app I’ve had for many years now is not free anymore! I’m in poverty I cannot afford 10 a month. Uninstalled. And SHAME ON YOU !!!

reviews.title: Why??
reviews.text:
The app was fine until the latest update.

I am only interested in the astronomical data and not all the other hooey so the new features are of no interest to me.

Unfortunately your app is now virtually unusable on my phone. My accessibility settings cause the screen display to become chaotic.

Finally, the options I have looked at are not as good as they used to be.

I am going to uninstall the app because I cannot use it. I am a premium subscriber so I would like a refund.

It’s a right pig’s ear. Why did you do it?

reviews.text: This app says the Moon is in Aquarius ♒️ right now but the Moon is actually in Pisces ♓️ this is not ok

reviews.title: Pay wall
reviews.text: I really liked this app. I purchased several things in this app and they keep  removing them and putting them back behind the pay wall with every new update. I am thinking about deleting it, because at this rate it is almost useless and a waste of money because they take it away again and restore purchase doesn’t give me my stuff back.

reviews.title: Beautiful and Informative
reviews.text:
Update: buyer beware. It looked like something was wrong with my app, so I selected Restore Purchases. I received a "Transaction complete" message and all of my data was wiped out. There was no transaction, just the removal of everything I had paid for previously. And to be clear, I had purchased most of the add-ons. I removed this app because I have no idea what the developer did to it or what it will do to my devices as a result. I do not recommend this app, and I do not recommend this developer. 

Old review: This is one of the most beautiful apps I have. It contains both practical and esoteric information about each day’s moon phase and the moon in general. It’s one of the few of my many apps that I try to check daily.
